title: Companies House approach to financial penalties
text:
The Registrar of Companies may issue financial penalties under the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 (Financial Penalty) Regulations 2024 .

 This document explains Companies House’s approach to financial penalties, including:

 • when Companies House can issue financial penalties

 • warning notices and penalty notices

 • making a representation

 • how Companies House calculates penalties

 • Companies House penalty amounts

 • paying a penalty

 • appealing a penalty

 • what happens if you do not pay your penalty
